summary.prose: Building this Story is a small, three-step change: add one new function to pending.ts that enumerates the same artifact files listPendingArtifacts already scans but without its pending/CR-sibling business rules, re-point insrc_present's existing handler at that new function instead, then extend the existing test files for both modules to prove the new presentability and the preserved error-path/ambiguity behavior. Nothing outside src/workflow/pending.ts, src/mcp/server.ts and their two existing test files changes.

tasks.title: Add resolveOpenableArtifacts to src/workflow/pending.ts
tasks.summary: Add the new exported function resolveOpenableArtifacts(repoPath): readonly {artifactId, mdPath}[], copying listPendingArtifacts' file-scan loop but keeping only the kind-filter (PENDING_KINDS) and the malformed-JSON try/catch guards; drop the approvalStateOf/AMD-status pending check and the BUILD/CR-sibling check entirely. Derive mdPath via the existing, already-exported deriveMdPath.
acceptanceChecks: resolveOpenableArtifacts returns an entry for a PENDING_KINDS artifact file regardless of its lifecycle status (draft, approved or rejected)
resolveOpenableArtifacts returns an entry for a non-standalone BUILD with no CR sibling
resolveOpenableArtifacts skips a malformed JSON file (logged) without dropping the rest of the scan
listPendingArtifacts itself is untouched -- no change to its own exported behavior

tests.name: resolveOpenableArtifacts returns a non-standalone BUILD with no CR sibling
resolveOpenableArtifacts excludes a non-PENDING_KINDS file (e.g. an EPIC/STORY/TASK record)
resolveOpenableArtifacts skips a malformed JSON file without dropping the rest of the scan

tasks.title: Wire handleInsrcPresent to resolveOpenableArtifacts
tasks.summary: Change handleInsrcPresent (src/mcp/server.ts) to read its openable set from resolveOpenableArtifacts instead of pending.artifacts (the listPendingArtifacts/pendingWorkflow call); keep namesPending and the ambiguity-filter (names matching more than one document stay notPending) unchanged. Remove the now-unused pendingWorkflow call/import if nothing else in the function needs it.
acceptanceChecks: handleInsrcPresent presents a tracked-epic BUILD by artifact id with no CR sibling (the reported defect's exact case)
handleInsrcPresent presents the same BUILD by its repo-relative doc path
handleInsrcPresent presents an already-approved or already-rejected artifact by name
handleInsrcPresent still reports notPending for a name matching zero artifacts
handleInsrcPresent still reports notPending for a bare filename matching more than one document
handleInsrcPresent's external response shape stays { presented: string[], notPending: string[] }

tasks.summary: Extend src/workflow/__tests__/pending.test.ts with resolveOpenableArtifacts unit tests (draft/approved/rejected artifact, non-standalone BUILD with no CR sibling, non-PENDING_KINDS exclusion, malformed-file skip), following that file's existing temp-repo fixture style, and extend handleInsrcPresent's own test file with the new presentability cases named in the test strategy.
